Settlement time refers to the amount of time between when a customer's payment is captured and those funds are available to be paid out to your bank account. The date and time that a customer's payment is captured is recorded in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
Funds from payments that are captured on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday are grouped and sent together as one payout.

The minimum settlement time depends on your region, risk level, and the payment method used. Some transactions, such as refunds and chargebacks, can settle faster than charges, and reduce your payout amount.
After funds are paid out, they might take an additional 1-3 days to display in your bank account. This depends on your bank's processing time and is out of Shopify’s control.

Scheduled The payout is in the process of being sent to your bank account.

Deposited The payout was sent to your bank. This doesn't mean that you have the funds in your bank account. Your bank might still need to process and deposit the funds into your account, which typically takes between 1-3 business days depending on your bank.
